description: Curated JMA/MRI T-PARCII aircraft and dropsonde pressure values. Every numeric pressure is an aircraft/dropsonde-derived measurement or estimate, never a best-track central pressure. Records with pressure_hpa=null document missions whose numeric value was not found in an accessible publication; they are not filled from best track.

records.time_precision: hour; published JST 16:00 converted to UTC
records.pressure_definition: minimum sea-level pressure estimated from inner-core dropsondes
records.source_kind: official joint press release (Ryukyus Univ., Nagoya Univ., MRI/JMA, JAMSTEC)
records.source_title: 2017年台風第21号の航空機観測を用いた強度解析と予測実験
records.note: Quality-controlled aircraft value after the official best-track release; the release compares it with the then-published best-track value, which is deliberately not copied here.

records.note: Original PTT thread M.1759822116.A.EBB, mirrored at disp.cc; twtybbs also reports a minimum of 959.0 hPa. Official JMA WIS TEMP_DROP directory currently retains no 2025 files, so the raw message could not be re-downloaded; value is retained only with this explicit non-official-forum provenance, not as an official archive copy.
